protocol.blind_observer: Muted stateless picture measurement, blind to case labels, source event observations and waveform. Find an unambiguous near-closed-to-open event against the publisher forced-phone neighborhood plus the fixed late control allowance. Keep ambiguous or missing observations.
protocol.controls: Lossless original, same-time ordinary 256-to-512 bilinear resample, five-picture delayed ordinary pixels. All share source crop, inverse affine, native mouth alpha, and edit interval. At the first and last edited picture use half opacity.
protocol.delivery: Lossless RGB H.264 and original mono float32 PCM in MOV. Preserve all exact native picture timestamps, zero origins, every source audio sample, and unchanged pixels outside the frozen edit geometry.
protocol.qualification: Rejoin labels after muted observation. Require that a neural or ordinary re-opening remains within one native picture of its genuine counterpart, lies inside the native edit interval, and differs from the separately measured acoustic burst by at most 80 ms. This is local source-event agreement, not perceptual phoneme or full-clip synchrony.
protocol.render: Rights-reviewed LivePortrait human weights, strict exact CPU float32 and unchanged bounded convolution. Use the same native source-time crop for both inputs. Reconstruction is an AI redraw and is not presumed synchronized.
protocol.roster: All 13 preselected qualified source events. Construct and observe the two development sources before the 11 held sources. Preserve every attempted condition and keep speakers disjoint.

released_timing_clock_admission.note: Exact source-clock upper bound before speaker attribution or mouth quality. Four windows begin at ticks 25, 37, 50, 62 and require 102 complete ticks.
